      Error Taxonomy
      
            
      Root-cause logging: L-GAP (lexical) · G-ERR (grammar) · T-MIS (distractor) · T-LIM (time). Identify systematic patterns to optimise remaining study time.
      
          
      
        
      
        
      
          
      What each code means
      
          
      One line per code, with an example, so a log entry always says what went wrong.
      
          
      
            
      
              
      
                Code
                Name
                What it means
                Example
              
      
              
                
      
                  L-GAP
                  Vocabulary gap
                  You did not know the word or collocation that the answer needed
                  “out of the blue” — did not know the phrase
                
      
                
      
                  G-ERR
                  Grammar error
                  You knew the words but the structure was wrong
                  “I have seen him yesterday”
                
      
                
      
                  T-MIS
                  Distractor trap
                  The answer was in the text but a wrong option looked right
                  two dates mentioned, picked the wrong one
                
      
                
      
                  T-LIM
                  Time limit
                  You ran out of time rather than getting it wrong
                  Part 5 unfinished at 0:00
